channel.title: Wire — AI
channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AX – Google’s Open Agentic Orchestrator
item.description: Declare an agentic task in YAML. AX sandboxes it, wires up its workspace, fences its network, and helps running it at scale. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Import AI 473: The US’s superintelligence strategy; human brain in a mouse skull; and machine hermeneutics
item.description: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers. If you’d like to support this, please subscribe. (1 source: importai)

item.title: Adversarial examples for fast hash functions
item.description: AI discovered collisions in komihash, a5hash, HighwayHash, SpookyHash, aHash, and t1ha2! It also includes the standard hashes in Rust, Go, and .NET. submitted by /u/thomasahle [link] [comments] (2 sources: lobsters, rprogramming)

item.title: Kubernetes 1.37 Released: Stable Metrics API and Rootless Kubelet in Beta
item.description: The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) announced the release of Kubernetes 1.37, named "Garhwal", emphasizing its focus on stability, security, and AI/ML workload optimization. By Mostafa Radwan (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Pirate Face Rescues LLM Models from Deletion
item.description: The un-bannable, checksum-verified mirror for sovereign AI models. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Article: Beyond Relevance: A Governance-First Architecture for Enterprise Personalization
item.description: This article examines the limitations of conventional personalization systems and highlights the need for a governance-first architecture. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Podcast: Securing AI Agents: Identity, Authorization, and the DPACT Framework
item.description: In this episode, Sahil Agarwal talks about the critical challenges of identity, authorisation, and security in the age of AI agents. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: The Agent Harness: Control Planes, Invariants, and Approval Boundaries for Production AI Agents
item.description: OpenAI’s Vinoth Govindarajan discusses why production AI agents fail beyond model hallucination. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Creating a Blog in Gemini://
item.description: Creating your own corner of Geminispace: why you'd want to blog on a protocol with no JavaScript, no CSS, and no AI slop; where to host a capsule (SmolPub,… (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Bun Rewrites 535K Lines of Zig into Rust in Four Months, Eliminates Numerous Memory Leaks
item.description: Bun creator Jarred Sumner recently announced that Bun, the JavaScript/TypeScript runtime, bundler and package manager has been rewritten from Zig to Rust. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Writing Your Own Allocator in Rust (and Why You Should)
item.description: I wrote a walkthrough of implementing a memory allocator from scratch in Rust. The article covers how memory management works, how bump allocation works, and how to implement an allocator in Rust. (1 source: rprogramming)
